p'tit: Some one had run ahead of her to where P’tit Maître sat with his family and guests upon the gallery.
Evening was near when P’tit Maître, black with powder and crimson with blood, had staggered into the cabin of Jacqueline’s mother, his pursuers close at his heels.
P’tit Maître had been there, and with him Doctor Bonfils, who said that La Folle might die.
